Patient: Dalia Abernethy | DOB: 11/09/1955 | MRN: SYN-3301971
Date of service: 04/30/2025 | Dr. Adele Grantham, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
69-year-old woman with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2021, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, seasonal allergies.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 33 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 38.
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
